a11y.fact: The component renders a native <progress> with max=100, so the progressbar role and value announcement are the browser's own.
The visible label is linked to the <progress> with aria-labelledby, using an id generated by React's useId.
When showLabel is false the label text is applied as aria-label so the progress bar keeps an accessible name.
The helper text is linked with aria-describedby when it is shown.
value is clamped to 0..100 (non-finite becomes 0) before it reaches the element and the value text.
